name: My Little Pop Star
source:
Anibal Hyde has a BIG stalker problem… 

Pop rock sensation Anibal finds herself held at gunpoint by her #1 stalker, Clotilde Terry. Only when Clotilde pulls the trigger, Anibal mysteriously shrinks to six inches tall! 

Now, trapped high in Clotilde’s hamster cage, Anibal must find a way to escape and (hopefully) get back to normal size! All without falling from her cage…or falling for her captor!  

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/my-little-pop-star]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿尼巴尔·海德有一个很大的跟踪者问题…… 

流行摇滚明星阿尼巴尔发现自己被排名第一的跟踪者克洛蒂尔德·特里用枪指着。只有当克洛蒂尔德扣动扳机时，阿尼巴尔才神秘地缩小到六英寸高！

现在，阿尼巴尔被困在克洛蒂尔德的仓鼠笼子里，必须找到逃脱的方法并（希望）恢复到正常大小！这一切都没有从她的笼子里掉下来……或者爱上她的俘虏！

[来自[url=https://norbez.itch.io/my-little-pop-star]Itch.io[/url]]
